records.title: Troop crossing in boats and a no-further-events ending; opening and place unresolved
records.header_literal: B) UKS v ZON (---- November 7th); RICHI-192; page heading 6th NOVEMBER, 1918
records.readable_german: SOCSTDENVU4RONEE4HE. LUHLEGKU?G. Uebersetzen von Truppen in Booten bei BRFIRBD9. Sonst nichts Wesentliches.
records.meaning: The ordinary-word proposal describes troops crossing in boats and ends with nothing further of significance. The preceding 19-label field, the LUHLEGKU?G token and the place-like BRFIRBD9 remain uninterpreted; no particular river, town, formation or successful crossing is independently established.
notes: The proposal repairs only five ordinary-word labels and fills two source-mask coordinates; the exact coordinate cost is listed in the certificate. No source position or key cell is changed without pricing.
The opening, the apparent reconnaissance token and the place-like string remain exactly as decoded. Their appearance in the readable display does not turn them into accepted German words.
The date heading and November 7 intercept header are both retained. The adjacent p144 C1 aerial report is a separate physical record; thematic proximity does not join their plaintexts.
The literal 4 and 9 labels in the opaque fields are retained. They are not relabeled as letters, separators or historical numbers to make an assumed geographical interpretation fit.

record.readable_german: 211?IVD marschiert bis 9 / 11 in Raum um TITELC. A. H. Q? 5 / 11 N?GQBECSER?K. Luftaufklaerung nichts Wesentliches.
record.title: March report and aerial reconnaissance with unresolved unit and place
record.meaning: The proposal reports a march by the unresolved unit label 211?IVD into the area around literal TITELC by 9/ 11. An A H Q? / 5/ 11 /N?GQBECSER?K clause follows. The aerial reconnaissance clause reports nothing substantial. No place, unit or missing interception day is silently supplied.
record.reading_note: The two five-dash groups occupy ten explicit source slots. The proposal fills six of them and changes two observed coordinates. Four plaintext positions remain unknown: one in the unit, one in Q?, and two in N?GQBECSER?K. TITELC remains literal, including its final C. The source omits the interception day; the plaintext date-like labels do not supply it.

independent_formula_support.scope: An independently fixed raw occurrence of the same routine phrase. It supports the proposed wording as an attested formula, not an identical-message or common-event claim. It does not support the optional nineteen-position opening.
